# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile portrait browser game titled "Derry Sewer Carnival: Brave the Float". Preserve the source mechanics: tap adjacent cells on a canvas grid, resolve random cards, update two survival stats, reveal a hidden exit object, win by reaching that revealed object, and lose when either stat reaches zero. Reinterpret the loop through IT carnival-horror adventure with Pennywise-like shapeshifting terror, childhood trauma, sewer dread, clown imagery, fear manifestation, and coming-of-age bravery for portrait mobile play. The player is a Losers Club kid moving through sewer drains; hazards are clown teeth, personal fear masks, and deadlights; rewards are arcade tokens, flashlight reveals, and a paper boat wake. Use procedural sewer/carnival/balloon visuals, compact mobile HUD, and approved catalog fonts/audio/GIF media.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: Mobile-first grid exploration / survival card adventure.
- objective: Move through adjacent grid rooms, resolve random encounter cards, reveal the hidden exit item, then reach it.
- input model: Pointer/touch tap on the canvas grid; only current or orthogonally adjacent tiles are actionable. Buttons use native click/tap.
- core loop: Start game -> tap adjacent tile -> draw encounter card -> resolve card effect -> update bravery/nerve and revealed tiles -> continue until paper boat exit is reached or stats reach zero.
- fail/friction state: Bravery or nerve depletion triggers the terminal fail screen; card overlay temporarily pauses movement resolution.

## Protected Mechanics
- 5x5 configurable grid, centered player spawn, randomly placed hidden exit, visited tile reveal, adjacent-only movement, card overlay resolution, stat changes, win on revealed exit, fail on depleted stat, restart path.

## Remix Trajectory
The Elm Street dream maze has been rebuilt as a Derry sewer carnival horror adventure: the same grid/card survival truth becomes a child navigating drains, fear masks, deadlights, clown teeth, red balloons, and a paper boat goal while preserving input, score/stat, collision, win/loss, and restart semantics.
